name: design-decisions
body: Design decisions: (1) Goldmark-style CommonMark AST walk to whitelist nodes, extensions disabled. (2) Go html/template for layouts (auto-escaping). (3) Live reload via a lightweight server push (SSE/websocket) endpoint; rebuild atomically swaps the rendered deck or error state (never partial). (4) Server binds 127.0.0.1 only. Default port 8080; if busy, try the next ports in order up to 8099 (20 ports total, 8080..8099); if all are busy, exit with a plain-language error advising `--port`. An explicit `--port N` that is busy = error (no fallback). The printed link shows the actual port. (5) No build/export: PDF via reveal.js ?print-pdf.
